name: Aris High JC Visual Novel
source: Who knew that getting into the most prestigious Junior College in Singapore would be the easy part? Now among the nation's brightest students, what will Ashlyn do when the two hottest guys in class both want the position of Class Representative... and her? Drama, romance, comedy, school slice-of-life: high school in Singapore has never been this complicated, or this much fun!
translation: 谁能想到，进入新加坡最负盛名的初级学院才是容易的部分？如今身处全国最优秀的学生之中，当班上最受欢迎的两个男生都想竞选班级代表……并且都想追求她时，艾什琳会怎么做？戏剧、恋爱、喜剧、校园日常：新加坡的高中生活从未如此复杂，也从未如此有趣！
